protocolMetadata.instructions: Flywheel is a graph-based system for tracking research work, decisions, and evidence over time. Flywheel MCP is the tool interface for reading and updating that graph. You can discover, create, and manage nodes. You can collaborate with other users and use managed compute. Refer to `flywheel_get_contract` and `flywheel_get_contract_section(section_id)` for details.

tool.name: flywheel_set_sharing_for_nodes
tool.description: Apply one sharing configuration across multiple owned nodes in bulk. One call changes at most 1000 distinct nodes (repeated node_ids count once); a call naming more is refused with 422 and changes nothing. Each call saves all or nothing: nodes you may not change are skipped and listed in `skipped` with a reason, and if the save fails no node changes. An error reported after the save (for example while reading the result back) can leave it saved, so read sharing back after an error. To share more than 1000 nodes, split node_ids into calls of at most 1000 each; every call is a separate save, so earlier calls stay saved if a later one fails.
